Maya: Quick sync on Mirror Park story & webinar assets. Interview set for Wed 11am PT. Need: 1 approved pull-quote, 20s webinar clip, and 10s demo b-roll. Rae can legal turn on same-day review?
Leo: I'll handle recording + clips. Will upload masters to Drive and drop a short transcript.
Flowbot: Upload placeholder: https://drive.redwood/mirrorpark/session_3625.mp4
Priya: I'll draft the blog blurb once we have the final quote. Can we avoid raw percentages in public copy?
Rae (legal): Policy: numeric claims need explicit customer signoff. We can publish non-numeric phrasing like "measurable cost reductions" without numbers. If they provide numbers, require email OK.
Hana (customer): Happy to do the interview. We can share numbers if Redwood can show the request to our legal team for sign-off.
Maya: Good. Hana's tentative quote (raw): "Redwood reduced our inference spend by 28% and improved p95 latency." Posting for legal.
Rae (legal): Please change to: "We saw measurable reductions in inference cost and faster latency" unless Hana's legal can email consent. I'll reach out to Hana's counsel.
Leo: I'll capture both versions live (numeric and cleaned) and mark timecodes for the approved clip.
Priya: For webinar lead routing, can Sales get a one-liner by noon? We want a short line for the slide and SDR playbook.
Maya: Yes — aim for a 1-sentence soundbite that avoids raw metrics.
Hana (customer): I'll read the cleaned line during the call if legal prefers that.
Flowbot: Reminder set: follow up with Rae in 3 hours.
Maya: Summary: Leo record + upload, Priya draft blog blur, Rae confirm publishable quote by EOD or request redaction, Hana give clean read during interview. Ping here if anything blocks. :sparkles:
